components.name: Chart/Usage meter
components.description: Quota or token usage with a projection to the reset date. Used = solid fill, Forecast = same colour at 35%. Normal (accent) < 80%, Warning (status/warning) 80–99% or forecast > 90%, Limit (status/danger) at 100%. Numbers in uz-UZ format with space separators. React: <UsageMeter used limit forecast resetAt label />
